title: Oven Roasted Maharashtrian Rice Fritters
description: Light, grassy rice fritters with a glassy, jelly‑like glaze, shaped like idli, perfect for a low‑calorie snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, puffed rice, peas, cilantro, mint, coconut, tamarind paste, ginger, garam masala, and salt until well blended.
Fold the egg wash into the rice mixture until it forms a slightly sticky batter.
Using a teaspoon, scoop the batter onto the prepared sheet, shaping each into a round idli‑like disc about 1 inch thick.
Brush each fritter lightly with oil to ensure a crisp edge.
Place the sheet in the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes, then flip each fritter and roast for an additional 15 minutes until golden brown and firm.
Remove from the oven and let the fritters cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Optionally, garnish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime for brightness.
Serve the fritters hot with green chutney or yogurt dip.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
